calls.evidence: Fakes posted as true (miamidolphins t01 c0001 'announcing a Cameron Wake trade to the Jets') and objections to the jokes (pebble t01 c0007 'calling the Pebble-is-back joke too soon') are different acts; rooms that stage fakes also object to them.
calls.contrary: An objection made inside a fake can sit either side: torontoraptors t01 c0002 'calling the fake injury ban worthy' in T3-001 against c0009 'asking mods to ... ban fake injury posts' in T3-032; detroitredwings t06 c0047 'leaving until tomorrow because the sub will be annoying' in T3-001.
calls.action: retain; T3-001's 'reply inside such a fake' and T3-032's three-concept floor mark the edge.

calls.evidence: Deciding the look (muse t02 c0064 'making the S one tile longer'; pitt t02 c0020 'choosing white for now') differs from instructions to follow (placesnek t04 c0043 'sharing a road map for long snek'; frc t01 c0011 'agreeing to put the coordinates in the post').
calls.contrary: A template embodies a design, and some design fixes are placed with the instructions (berserk t06 c0083 'proposing how to line up the horizontal banner' in T3-070).

calls.evidence: Celebrating ('celebrating that they did it') differs from recounting what happened to the work (leafs t05 c0086 'recounting the logo's decay from TML through FML to FAIL').
calls.contrary: A plain survival statement meets both, B4's defect (sheffield t08 c0053 'announcing that Sheffield survived to the end in full' in T3-073; edboxes t08 c0078 'recounting making it to the end more or less intact' in T3-009).
calls.action: retain; the edge was left at C1a-05 as a defensible second reading.

calls.evidence: Building and progress (rangers t04 c0007 'starting the NYR logo under the Indian flag') differ from upkeep (rangers t04 c0116 'undoing graffiti and out-of-place pixels'); the same placers move from one to the other.
calls.contrary: Fixing during the first build sits either side (pathofexile t06 c0046 'nearly fixing the L' in T3-038).

calls.evidence: Calls for hands (bardmains t01 c0035 'asking for help with a Bard sign') differ from placing and progress (ethoslab t01 c0008 'placing the first square at 463, 33'); a start announced with a call does both.
calls.contrary: Calls are placed with the build (bangtan t01 c0001 'calling on the room to make the BTS logo' in T3-038; nyjets t04 c0037 'beginning the drawing at 125, 123 and asking others to join').
calls.action: retain; T3-002's count rule (an opening call does not lead because it comes first) is the edge.

calls.evidence: Arguing whether scripts are fair (pakistan t08 c0089 'saying a script defeats the point') differs from running them (pakistan t08 c0223 'answering a script request with a Pastebin link'); the argument rides on the running.
calls.contrary: Running a script while calling it dishonest is one turn (starcitizen t12 c0228, placed T3-028).

calls.evidence: Settling lines and space (criticalrole t08 c0063 'accepting minimal overlap') differs from an alliance to defend together (southafrica t04 c0085 'proposing an alliance to defend all the flags together').
calls.contrary: Space-for-help bargains are placed under T3-010 (polska t02 c0038 'offering help extending the flag in return for leaving AMD alone'), a T3-151 act.

calls.contrary: A call from the chat to come and place sits in T3-152 (bangtan t04 c0011 'bringing people from Discord to work on the B').
